PlayerRestrictedAreaFile.description: PlayerRestrictedAreaFile defines a restricted player area and safe positions for that area.

PRABoxes.description: PRABoxes defines rotated 3D boxes. Each box contains three XYZ vectors in order: size, rotation, and world position.

areaName.description: AreaName is an optional label used to identify the area in game diagnostics.

safePositions3D.description: SafePositions3D lists explicit XYZ destinations used when selecting a safe position for this area.
